subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB1234 Departure: [Date] at [Time] from [Airport] Arrival: [Date] at [Time] at Charles de Gaulle Airport. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. Have a pleasant journey! Regards, XYZ Airlines
